name: crm
description: Frappe CRM helps you work, not slow you down. Open-source, intuitive, and free from extra costs.
author: Frappe Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

scripts.build: if [ -d 'crm/public/frontend/assets' ] && [ -z "$FORCE_REBUILD" ]; then echo '[skip-build] pre-built artifacts present at crm/public/frontend/assets (set FORCE_REBUILD=1 to force rebuild)'; else yarn build:force; fi
scripts.upgrade-frappeui: cd frontend && yarn add frappe-ui@latest && cd ..
